summary: Fixes installs served under a subpath (e.g. example.com/paperless/): after a password change the logout/login redirect keeps the subpath, expired/missing share links redirect to the correct login page, and the auto-login middleware now recognises token requests under a subpath (so a POST to /api/token/ uses the posted credentials instead of the auto-login user).

statements.why: Redirect URL fixes plus a narrow auth-middleware path check; nothing newly risky.

misses.what: For installs hosted under a subpath: after changing a password users are now sent to the right logout/login page, and expired or missing share links go to the right login page instead of a broken address.

Login fix under a subpath: with auto-login enabled, requests for an API token were being treated as the auto-login user instead of using the username/password posted; now they use the posted credentials.
